title: Zesty Greek Brie Skillet
description: A bitter, fluffy, and energizing Greek dish featuring brie, flambe, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Preheat the cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped sun dried tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the chopped artichoke hearts and cook for 2 minutes until they are heated through.
Add the pitted kalamata olives and cook for 1 minute until they are slightly caramelized.
Add the softened brie cheese and stir until it is melted and smooth.
Add the chopped fresh parsley, lemon juice, and red pepper flakes, and stir to combine.
Use a kitchen torch to flambe the mixture, or place the skillet under the broiler for 1-2 minutes until the top is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
